moments.title: Taylor Swift's Chart Double
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift has secured an Official Chart Double in the UK, with her new single 'Patient Zero' debuting at Number 1 and 'The Life Of A Showgirl' returning to the top of the Official Albums Chart.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Taylor Swift does the chart double! 'Patient Zero' is your new UK #1 single, and 'The Life Of A Showgirl' is back atop the albums chart. What a week for Swifties!

angles.name: Queen of the Charts
angles.copy: Three UK Number 1 singles in 2026 alone for Taylor Swift! 'Patient Zero' joins 'Opalite' and 'I Knew It, I Knew You' in a record-breaking year. Which one's your fave?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Top 10
moments.blurb: Siena Spiro holds onto the UK Number 1 spot for a third week with 'Great Expectation', while Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' debuts at Number 1, and 'Cleveland!' and 'Babylon' also enter the Top 5.

angles.name: Chart Breakdown
angles.copy: The Official Singles Chart Top 10 is buzzing! Siena Spiro holds strong at #1, but Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is making waves. What's on your weekend playlist?

angles.name: Female Domination
angles.copy: For only the second time in chart history, the UK Top 6 singles are all by female artists! Siena Spiro, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, Adéla, Dua Lipa, and Olivia Rodrigo are owning the charts.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting

angles.name: Music Icon
